steps.caption: Price book
steps.narration: Some quantities come from a measurement and a little math. The Formulas tab lets you test that math.

steps.caption: Formulas
steps.narration: In the Price book, open the Formulas tab.

steps.caption: A sample formula
steps.narration: A sample formula is filled in. It takes the squares, adds the waste percent, and rounds up.

steps.caption: Sample numbers
steps.narration: Underneath are sample numbers to test with. Thirty-two squares, and ten percent waste.

steps.caption: The answer
steps.narration: The answer is thirty-six, and it names the symbols the formula used.

steps.caption: Another case
steps.narration: Change a number to check another case.

steps.caption: Test again
steps.narration: And test again. Forty-five squares come to fifty.

steps.caption: Your own formula
steps.narration: You can type your own formula. Symbols go in square brackets.

steps.caption: Test it
steps.narration: This one counts three for every square, plus waste. Test it.

steps.caption: The new answer
steps.narration: The tester works it out with the same sample numbers.

steps.caption: Available symbols
steps.narration: The line underneath lists every symbol a formula may use, such as squares, linear feet and hours.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: Formulas is the last tab of the Price book, in the left menu.

youtube.title: How to test a price book formula | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: Check the math before you rely on it. The Formulas tab of the ConstructHUB CRM price book tests a formula with sample measurements: use the sample, change the numbers, or type your own formula with symbols such as squares and waste. Recorded in a demo workspace.
